worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.summary: Coil your thoughts into a short offensive window: Special Attack rises sharply, but the window is brief, so land special attacks right away. It needs no foe, so you can scheme before a fight. When the window ends or is cleared, only the stages this move raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.0: Before closing in, a quick scheme raises Sp. Atk
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.1: Start the scheme when a foe shows, then spend the short window on special attacks
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.2: Scheme ahead of the fight and spend the short window on the first special attack
Nasty Plot raises Special Attack by %1$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.wary.on: Careful scheme: Sp. Atk +2 and a slightly longer window, but 1 more windup tick and a longer cooldown; usable at any time, no foe required.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.wary.off: Quick scheme: Sp. Atk +1 and a shorter window, but a faster windup and cooldown. Strong-but-slow against weak-but-fast, each has its moment.
The scheme lasts about %1$s, a short window set only by its own duration and clearing. When the window ends or is cleared, only the Sp. Atk stages this scheme raised are taken back. You hold position while casting.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.growth.0: At level %1$s the scheme's cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.growth.1: At level %1$s the scheme's cooldown drops further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.preference.w: On: careful scheme, Sp. Atk +2 and a slightly longer window, but 1 more windup tick and a longer cooldown. Off: quick scheme, Sp. Atk +1 and a shorter window with a faster windup and cooldown. Both work at any time with no foe required.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.preference.a: Consider a scheme when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of scheming; larger gives up setup more often up close.
